english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for something continuing or enduring over a period of time.
Use this for a situation, process, or relationship continuing or lasting without emphasizing hardship or personal effort.

examples.english: The rain will last all afternoon.
examples.traditional: 呢場雨會持續成個下晝。
examples.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 jyu5 wui5 ci4 zuk6 sing4 go3 haa6 zau3

examples.english: This relationship did endure for many years.
examples.traditional: 呢段關係持續咗好多年。
examples.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 gwaan1 hai6 ci4 zuk6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4
